messages:
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone for the all-hands. Quick ask: can we have a single-line summary of why we won vs why we lost deals this quarter, plus the top customer asks we should prioritize? Looking for concrete next steps to feed into roadmap.
Rajiv Menon: From GTM + CS synthesis: wins = clear deploy playbook (fast PoC), reliable demo perf, responsive security posture. Losses = missing formal compliance packages, surprised cost at scale, and lack of pinned model guarantees.
Samir Patel: Data point from reps: ~45% of stalled enterprise deals cite compliance questions, ~25% cite cost uncertainty, ~30% cite product features (pinning/customization). These are rough but consistent across segments.
Leah O'Neill: CS perspective: customers repeatedly ask for a one-page security summary, an install checklist for Private, and a short TCO example calculation they can use in procurement decks. When we provide those, conversion improves.
Nora Kim: Product asks we keep hearing: (1) model pinning / guaranteed variants, (2) cheaper long-context options or token caps, (3) deterministic rollout controls for model updates. All three are plausible roadmap items with varying effort.
Jin Park: Engineering quick wins: publish a Private runbook + sample commands (weeks), add a TCO calc template to docs (days), and ship a model-pinning beta API (4-6 weeks). Longer-term: quantized long-context runtime to cut unit costs (quarter). Example run snippet for runbook: ```bash
./deploy-private.sh --validate --tenant acme-corp
```
Maya Chen: Can each proposed item have an owner + one-line acceptance criteria and ETA? I'll compile and include in the exec planning doc.
Rajiv Menon: SOC2 & compliance packet -> Heather V (Security) + Rajiv: acceptance = signed attestation + customer-facing packet; ETA = 30 days.
Samir Patel: Pricing/TCO experiments -> Samir: acceptance = experiment shows >=10% conversion lift on mid-market offers; ETA = 14 business days for initial results.
Leah O'Neill: Private runbook + security one-pager -> Leah: acceptance = published runbook + 2 verified customer installs; ETA = 10 business days.
Nora Kim: Model-pinning beta -> Nora + Jin: acceptance = API + beta with 2 customers and rollback hooks; ETA = 30-45 days.
Jin Park: Perf mitigations (autoscale tuning + cache warmup) -> Jin: acceptance = documented mitigations + p95 improvement on benchmark cluster; ETA = 2-3 weeks.
ops-bot: All-hands recording & notes: https://redwood.internal/records/allhands-2026-03-22-followup ; action tracker: https://redwood.internal/actions/1979991111
Maya Chen: Great. Let's reconvene in 2 weeks with owners posting a 1-line status update here. If anyone hits blockers please @me. :thumbsup:
Leah O'Neill: Will validate the runbook with 2 customers this week and post results.
Samir Patel: I'll kick off the pricing A/B and share a brief with GTM in 10 business days.
Nora Kim: Starting the model-pinning RFC today; will tag beta partners.
Rajiv Menon: I'll coordinate with Security to produce the compliance packet and share the draft by EOD Friday.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone 97 actionable summary and owners = exactly what we needed.
